en:
Vertigo - a sensation that you, or the environment around you, 
is moving or spinning.
ru:
Vertigo - ощущение, что вы или окружающий мир 
движется или вращается.

en:
Vertigo - a common physical symptom that results in a sensation of movement, 
usually a spinning feeling.

Vertigo - a spinning sensation that distorts one's sense of balance and causes 
a feeling of nausea or being off balance.

Vertigo - a physiological phenomenon characterized by a false perception of motion 
when there is no external stimulus present.

Vertigo is defined in medicine as a false sensation of movement, 
and is often caused by a dysfunction in the inner ear or brain.

Vertigo is but an illusion of the mind brought forth from an imbalance of bodily perception. 
It reveals the limitations of our physical bodies and the fragility of our grasp on reality.
ru:
Головокружение это всего лишь иллюзия разума, вызванная дисбалансом телесного восприятия. 
Оно показывает ограниченность нашего физического тела и хрупкость нашего понимания реальности.

en: Oh, Vertigo, you ever so inviting...
...As I spiral deeper, my mind twists and turns.
As the emeralds flash in my eyes...
...The colors move, blinding me, and I lose myself to Vertigo.
The crimson sunset fades, and I feel the cold on my skin...
...The Vertigo is always by my side.
And we dance and dance around the burning sun...
...Oh Vertigo, my sunflower. You are always by my side.
As the clouds pass, covering the sun...
...The Vertigo awaits, ready to take me away.
As the delusion grows, and the disconnect intensifies...
...The walls are built by Vertigo, to keep me safe.
With each wave, I brace. And I take comfort in knowing...
...The tide of Vertigo will sweep me away.
As the inner peace is found...
...The Vertigo comes back to rip it from me, tormenting my mind.
As the ground gives way beneath my feet...
...I gather strength for my stand against the Vertigo.
As I sit in silence, counting the days...
...The Vertigo lets my dreams slip through my hands.
Oh, dear Vertigo, pull me away...
...I can't stop the tremor, the quiver of my breath.
...I feel the warmth embrace of Vertigo, englufing me in apnea.
...And the spiral comes to an end.
Fragile life derailed by the medical condition of Vertigo.
Her vision is distorted with swirling lights, her sense of reality twisted.
She struggles through the world rapidly changing around her.
